summary.text: Will Tuell is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 10, in office since December 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Genevieve Lemire. He also served in the House from 2014 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: William Tuell graduated from Washington Academy in 1996 and earned a degree in history from the University of Maine at Machias in 2001.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a publicist and board member with the Sunrise County Economic Council, a writer for the Downeast Coastal Press and a freelance writer, and he has served on the board of directors of Arise Addiction Recovery.
He was also elected a selectman for the Town of East Machias.
Tuell represented District 139 in the Maine House from 2014 to 2022, then returned to the House for District 10 on December 3, 2024, succeeding Kenneth Davis.
